Name: Main Controller
Description: Compact microcontroller for safety monitoring and basic system control.

Name: High Voltage Power Supply
Description: Step-up transformer providing high voltage AC for the primary circuit.

Name: Input Power Variac
Description: Adjustable AC transformer to control the input voltage and power level.

Name: Primary Capacitor Bank
Description: Bank of capacitors storing energy for discharge into the primary coil.

Name: Static Spark Gap
Description: Adjustable electrodes that break down and conduct high voltage, initiating oscillation.

Name: Main Power Control Relay
Description: Switches AC power to the HVPS based on MCU commands and safety interlocks.

Name: Emergency Stop Button
Product Name: Mushroom Head Emergency Stop Switch NO/NC
Description: Normally closed switch to immediately cut power for safety.

Name: Safety Key Switch
Description: Key-operated switch to arm/disarm the system, preventing accidental operation.

Name: Ballast Inductor
Description: Limits current from the HVPS to prevent damage during spark gap firing.

Name: Acrylic Base Plate
Description: Non-conductive base for mounting all components.

Name: PVC Secondary Coil Form
Description: Insulating form for winding the secondary coil.

Name: Acrylic Support Rods
Description: Supports for the secondary coil assembly and safety enclosure.

Name: Non-Conductive Top Load Rod
Description: Insulating rod connecting the spherical top load to the secondary coil.

Name: Stainless Steel Top Load Sphere
Description: Capacitive terminal at the top of the secondary coil for enhanced output.

Name: Acrylic Safety Panels
Description: Transparent panels to enclose the high-voltage components for safety.

Name: M3 Nylon Standoffs
Description: Insulating standoffs for mounting PCBs and other small components.

Name: M3 Screws and Nuts
Description: General purpose fasteners for assembling mechanical and electrical components.

Name: M4 Screws and Nuts
Description: Heavier duty fasteners for mounting larger components like the variac or HVPS.

Name: HVPS Mounting Bracket
Description: Custom bracket to securely mount the High Voltage Power Supply.

Name: Variac Mounting Bracket
Description: Custom bracket to securely mount the Input Power Variac.

Name: Capacitor Bank Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the Primary Capacitor Bank.

Name: MCU Enclosure/Mount
Description: Small enclosure to protect and mount the Main Controller (Arduino Nano).

Name: Adjustable Spark Gap Mount
Description: Mount with adjustment mechanism for the static spark gap electrodes.

Name: Primary Coil Support Ring
Description: Insulating ring to support the primary coil windings around the secondary coil base.

Name: Secondary Coil Base Mount
Description: Mount for securing the PVC secondary coil form to the base plate.

Name: Secondary Coil Top Mount
Description: Mount for attaching the top load rod to the top of the secondary coil form.

Name: Control Panel Mounts
Description: Mounts for the E-stop and Key Switch on an enclosure panel.
